name: WoobleOS
description: FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald: the PC becomes a modern desktop in a monitor. It boots with the W, then shows a home screen of apps with a dock and a menu bar, made for touch and controllers and just as easy with a mouse and keyboard. The apps open the game's own Pokémon Storage, Item Storage, Hall of Fame and Prof. Oak's PC.
